summary: Tillamook County, OR site with a 1930s crow's nest and a 1943 AWS cabin; listed abandoned with ruins; one map list says partly standing; no source says gone.

facts.design: 1930s crow's nest; 1943 AWS cabin (12x29) and woodshed (12x16)
facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned, with ruins on site; one map list counts it among partly standing lookouts, which no other source we read confirms.
facts.agency: Northwest Oregon FPA (firelookout.com); Oregon Department of Forestry (Oregon lookouts history)

events.note: Crow's nest, dated only to the 1930s by firelookout.com
AWS cabin and woodshed built at the Foley Lookout, per the 1943 annual report quoted by the Oregon lookouts history

corrections.why: firelookout.com lists the site as abandoned with ruins on site; the ruins describe what remains, and no source we read says the site is gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com names the Northwest Oregon FPA; the Oregon lookouts history names the Oregon Department of Forestry. The story reports both; these sources do not explain how the two relate.

A Best Maps list says it shows lookouts that remain at least partially standing and includes Foley Peak; firelookout.com describes abandoned ruins. The list gives no detail, so the story reports the disagreement.
firelookout.com dates a crow's nest to the 1930s and the AWS cabin to 1943. The record's 1943 date fits the cabin, not the earlier crow's nest.

notes_for_editor: The record's status 'gone' is not supported; firelookout.com says 'Abandoned. Ruins.' The brief's note that firelookout.com says 'standing' does not match the fetched page. Agency conflict: Northwest Oregon FPA (firelookout.com) vs Oregon Department of Forestry (Oregon lookouts history). firelookout.com also says '8 miles southeast of Newhalem', which does not fit Tillamook County (Newhalem is in Washington State), so it is not used. A Facebook group post mentions a 'cabin in ruins' but is social media and is not used. No access, current-condition, or staffing source beyond the 1943 activation date.
